compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-4: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic — realized here as a registered, executable structural-boundary test suite that drives assertions against the actual producer artifact plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md, verifying the Migration-Class Pair Emission contract markers; reverting task-2's prompt edit makes the suite go RED.

## Implementation
Create `tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh` — a STRUCTURAL BOUNDARY TEST (behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5: the legitimate non-human-consumer / structural-boundary test for a non-executable LLM instruction file). The suite MUST execute its assertions against the ACTUAL producer artifact `plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md` (resolve via `REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)`), NOT against self-authored fixtures. The suite parses/greps the "Migration-Class Pair Emission" section for the required contract markers.

LITMUS (regression contract): reverting task-2's prompt edit MUST make this suite RED; with task-2's edit present it goes GREEN. Because the section does not yet exist, the suite is RED on creation and turns GREEN only after task-2 lands — the intended RED-before-GREEN ordering.

Contract markers the suite MUST assert on plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md (assert each as a named, individually-failing assertion):
1. A "Migration-Class Pair Emission" section heading exists (dispatch-point marker).
2. The dispatch point is keyed on migration-class (a per-class dispatch case present).
3. The sweep case names BOTH reserved task-type namespaces as distinct tokens: automated-sweep AND manual-verification.
4. The sweep case specifies transform_descriptor as a token DISTINCT from detection_query (both present, named separately).
5. recipe-preferred / agent-sweep fallback encoded: automated-sweep emits recipe task_type + recipe_id on registry match, else code task_type with the agent-sweep token (final executor selection deferred to sprint via translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh).
6. The manual-verification done-definition contains THREE distinct, individually-named clauses (a/b/c below).
7. db / flag-tag reserved headers present (reserved for ef21/c5fa; named as reserved, NOT active cases).

The three manual-verification done-definition clauses (each a separate named assertion):
- (a) re-run the detection query AND assert zero remaining sites;
- (b) un-automatable sites recorded as inline TODO(migration) markers enumerated in an un_automatable_sites field;
- (c) the test gate must pass over the modified files (a zero detection count WITHOUT a passing test gate is NOT complete).

Fixtures: the two JSON fixtures (tests/implementation-plan/fixtures/sweep-pair-recipe-hit.json, sweep-pair-agent-fallback.json) MAY be retained ONLY as schema-validated example inputs consumed by a parsing helper — NEVER the sole assertion subject. The authoritative assertion subject is task-decomposer.md. If the fixtures add no parsing-helper value, OMIT them rather than assert against them (avoids the tautological self-authored-fixture defect).

Registration: chmod +x the new .sh file and add a `.test-index` entry (at the REPO-ROOT .test-index) so the test gate discovers it — append the new test path to the existing task-decomposer.md / migration-class source mapping or add a new line mapping plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md to tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh.

## TDD Test Spec
Given plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md WITHOUT a Migration-Class Pair Emission section (task-2 not yet landed); When test-sweep-pair-emission.sh runs its structural-boundary assertions against that actual artifact; Then the suite exits non-zero (RED) — the dispatch-point, namespace, transform_descriptor-distinctness, the three named manual-verification clauses, and the db/flag-tag-reserved assertions each fail individually; once task-2 adds the section the same suite exits 0 (GREEN), and reverting task-2's edit returns it to RED.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh
- [ ] Suite is registered in the repo-root .test-index so the test gate discovers it
  Verify: grep -q 'test-sweep-pair-emission.sh' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] Suite asserts against the ACTUAL producer artifact (task-decomposer.md), not fixtures as the sole subject
  Verify: grep -q 'task-decomposer.md' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh
- [ ] RED-marker before task-2 lands: with the section absent, the suite exits non-zero
  Verify: { ! grep -q 'Migration-Class Pair Emission' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && { bash tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh; test $? -ne 0; }; } || echo 'section present (task-2 landed) — verify GREEN instead'
- [ ] Suite asserts both reserved namespaces (automated-sweep AND manual-verification)
  Verify: grep -q 'automated-sweep' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh && grep -q 'manual-verification' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh
- [ ] Suite asserts transform_descriptor distinct from detection_query
  Verify: grep -q 'transform_descriptor' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh && grep -q 'detection_query' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh
- [ ] Suite asserts clause (a) zero-remaining-sites as a distinct named assertion
  Verify: grep -qiE 'zero.*remaining|remaining.*site' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh
- [ ] Suite asserts clause (b) un_automatable_sites with TODO(migration) markers
  Verify: grep -q 'un_automatable_sites' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh && grep -q 'TODO(migration)' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh
- [ ] Suite asserts clause (c) test-gate-passes-over-modified-files as a distinct named assertion
  Verify: grep -qiE 'test.gate' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh
- [ ] Suite asserts db/flag-tag reserved headers present
  Verify: grep -q 'flag-tag' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
